task: target-field referee whistle; neighbouring-field whistles are interference
ground_truth: valid channel0 publisher start/end labels; no core fields and no automatic anomaly repair
prediction_validity: integer original-sample position, 0 <= estimated_start_sample < file sample_frames

assignment_objectives: minimize sum of absolute onset errors
deterministic ties by prediction index then label index

unmatched_predictions: count every unmatched prediction as FP; do not silently merge during evaluation
duplicate_definition: unmatched prediction within onset tolerance of an already matched target; report as duplicate and FP
detector_event_merge: part of detector; parameters selected on development/validation, frozen before test
false_alarm_per_hour_denominator: sum of full scored file durations in channel0 / 3600; not doubled by stereo
undefined_metrics: zero denominator -> null with reason; never substitute 100 percent
error_scope: only matched events; report FN alongside onset errors
decision_delay: (decision_sample - ground_truth_start_sample) / native_sample_rate; separate from processing wall time
end_at_eof: retain valid event for onset evaluation; exclude its end from natural-offset accuracy
secondary_rule: same frozen predictions; supplementary only; never replace primary 0.2s result or retune
reference_whistlelab_protocol: optional supplementary only, separate from primary onset matching
acceptance_target: not established; tolerance is a scoring rule, not measured timestamp precision
